sources.title: Obsidian Help — Bases
sources.claim: Bases is officially defined by Obsidian as a core plugin that lets you create database-like views of your notes, storing data in local Markdown files and their properties.

sources.title: Obsidian October 2025
sources.claim: Obsidian launched Bases as a new core plugin in 1.9; 1.10 added Bases APIs for custom view layouts.

sources.title: Neowin — Obsidian 1.9.0 launches
sources.claim: Obsidian 1.9.0 Desktop became available in early access on May 21, 2025 with Bases as the headline feature.

sources.title: Obsidian 1.9.2 changelog
sources.claim: The Bases file format and formula syntax were refined in 1.9.2 with file properties and chainable functions.

sources.title: Obsidian Rocks — Dataview vs Datacore vs Bases
sources.claim: Bases require no coding — created and edited entirely with a visual editor — and are fast even on large vaults.

sources.title: optional.page — Bases
sources.claim: A base is a table of notes selected by filters, with two sequential filter layers (All views, then This view).

sources.title: Obsidian Observer — Bases is the biggest update since Properties
sources.claim: Community framing: Bases is the biggest Obsidian update since Properties.

sources.title: Practical PKM — Moving to Obsidian Bases from Dataview
sources.claim: Bases is positioned as the official, first-party successor to the Dataview community plugin.

sources.title: Obsidian Help — Create a base
sources.claim: Three ways to create a new base: command palette, right-click folder, or ribbon.

sources.title: Obsidian Help — Bases syntax
sources.claim: A .base YAML file has five top-level sections: filters, formulas, properties, summaries, views.

sources.title: Obsidian Help — Bases views
sources.claim: Bases ships four built-in view layouts: Table, Cards, List, Map.

sources.title: Obsidian Help — Cards view
sources.claim: Cards view configuration includes card width, an image property, and a cover/contain image fit setting.

sources.title: Obsidian Rocks — Getting started with Bases
sources.claim: Practical filter workflow with file → has tag.

sources.title: got.md — Obsidian Bases
sources.claim: A useful starting column set is file.name, two or three note properties, and a temporary file.path.

sources.title: uroybd/Book-Base
sources.claim: A complete community book-library base with six views and formulas for cover, rating, series.

sources.title: Practical PKM — From Books to Bases
sources.claim: Practical PKM book-library recipe with a folder filter and three views.

sources.title: tamarisk.it — Tracking reading with Bases
sources.claim: Reading-log recipe with readDates array filtering by year.

sources.title: Forum — Bases template for project tracking
sources.claim: Forum template standardising status, passion, deadline, progress as project keys.

sources.title: Forum — My home base tutorial
sources.claim: Home base tutorial with whole-vault Note Checklist and a Projects & Exams tag-filter base.

sources.title: Effortless Academic — Meeting note template & Base
sources.claim: Two bases off a Type=='Meeting' schema using Attendees.contains(this.file).

sources.title: Shreshth-mehra/Obsidian-TV-Tracker
sources.claim: TV Tracker plugin's movie/TV media-log frontmatter shape, directly usable as a Bases source schema.

sources.title: Forum — Bases of Bases with thumbnail images
sources.claim: Bases of Bases cards view with thumbnail formula file.basename + '.jpg'.

sources.title: Forum — Recipe sheet
sources.claim: Community recipe-database template tagged #🍽️/recipe with a multi-select ingredients property.

sources.title: Practical PKM — Bases limitations
sources.claim: Bases lacks GROUP BY; only ships Table and Cards; requires YAML frontmatter, not inline.

sources.title: Quorafind/Bases-Toolbox
sources.claim: Dataview-to-Bases converter web tool supporting TABLE queries with most clauses.

sources.title: Hacker News — Bases discussion
sources.claim: HN users call Bases roughly a 90% replacement for Dataview; Datacore stalled.

sources.title: dandylyons.net — Goodbye Dataview, hello Bases
sources.claim: Dataview DQL is brittle, has no GUI, is read-only, and isn't supported by Obsidian Publish.

sources.title: Medium — Dataview is dead, long live Bases
sources.claim: Commentators frame Dataview as resting in a long-term academic sabbatical.

sources.title: blacksmithgu/obsidian-dataview
sources.claim: Dataview repo has ~9k stars; shipped 0.5.70 on April 7 2025 with no sunset notice.

sources.title: Forum — Dataview vs Bases
sources.claim: Bases only operates at note level and does not read inline properties or inline tasks.

sources.title: Forum — Bases support for tasks
sources.claim: Bases cannot index individual tasks because task details live in file body.

sources.title: Forum — Base formulas date timestamp bug
sources.claim: The Bases date() formula fails on ISO8601 timestamps with seconds/offset and on this.file.ctime.

sources.title: Forum — Bases horizontal scrolling broken
sources.claim: Bases has no working horizontal scroll for wide tables.

sources.title: Forum — Bug: filters in Bases
sources.claim: Filter equality on array properties is inconsistent; use .contains() as workaround.

sources.title: Forum — Bases is slow and stuttery
sources.claim: Bases can stutter even on small datasets; disable hardware acceleration as workaround.

sources.title: Forum — Base not showing on iPhone iOS
sources.claim: Bases sync to iOS but render empty rows despite identical desktop data.

sources.title: Obsidian Roadmap
sources.claim: Kanban view is in progress; Calendar view and Publish support are planned.

sources.title: Practical PKM — 2026 Obsidian Report Card
sources.claim: Bases scored 4.4/5 community but is flagged work-in-progress with steep learning curve.

sources.title: Forum — Bases mobile create/duplicate focus bug
sources.claim: iPad/iOS create-or-duplicate-view fails to focus the new view.

sources.title: Forum — Bases embed height/scroll request
sources.claim: Embedded Bases have no display-height limit or vertical scrollbar.

sources.title: Obsidian Help — Bases functions
sources.claim: Global functions: if(), now(), today(), date(), duration(), link(), list(), image(), icon(), min/max, number().

sources.title: Forum — Metadata index stale when plugin edits frontmatter
sources.claim: Plugins writing via app.vault.modify() can leave the metadata index stale until cache rebuild.
